kevin (PM): quick thread: need a fast-fallback + rebalance heuristic for reserved pools when a region has short spikes. aim to reduce tail and keep guarantees for hard-reserved tenants.

sophia (Eng-Platform): idea: two-layer fallback. first try in-pool spillover to nearby micro-pools (best-effort), then cross-region soft-fallback if latency budget allows. keep decision cheap: bitflags + capacity window check.

deepa (SRE): must cap cross-region fallbacks per-tenant to avoid network storms. add max-cross-region-per-hour and circuit when queue latency > 150ms.

amir (Data): suggest a rebalance score = committed_ratio*0.6 - recent_spike_score*0.4; pick donors with highest score. prevents taking from noisy tenants.

ryan (Product Ops): customers want explainability: console message should say "fallback -> micro-pool" or "fallthrough -> cross-region" with suggested action. also opt-in for cross-region for compliance-sensitive tenants.

sophia (Eng-Platform): runtime sketch: cached tenant flags + pool snapshot, compute donor list async; immediate admit decision uses earliest donor or queue. pseudo:

```
if (tenant.hard_reserved) keep_local_only
else if (pool.has_micro_spare) use_micro_pool
else if (tenant.cross_region_ok && global_budget>0) route_cross_region
else queue
```

deepa (SRE): metrics for rollout: 1) canary p99 delta <=5%, 2) cross-region fallbacks <0.2% of requests, 3) no more than 1 unexpected preempt per-tenant in 24h.

capacity-bot: scheduled: micro-pool rebalance sim at 1758123465.

kevin (PM): action items: sophia -> implement cached fast-path + donor selector; amir -> refine rebalance score thresholds; deepa -> circuit thresholds and alerts; ryan -> console copy and opt-in toggle spec. target: small canary next week.

sophia (Eng-Platform): noted, will open PR for fast-path and sim harness.

kevin (PM): thanks, keeping this as canonical thread.
